summary: BrainsWay Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and TASE, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a strategic collaboration with Mindful Health Solutions, whose managed services organization was acquired in August by Radial Health, Inc., forming a 27-location brain-medicine clinic network across seven states. No transaction terms, equity consideration, pricing, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing, or closing conditions were disclosed. Separately, BrainsWay noted a $0.8m follow-on equity investment in the management services organization servicing Texas-based Heading Health. Commercial partnership rather than a special situation; watch for any shift toward equity stakes or consolidation.
